description: Durable numeric ledger for the inner-tomi minimal repairs (2026-10-05 plan). Coordinates are half-open, source index zero based, PDF page one based. Mask/compaction rows are recorded in original (full-source) coordinates; retained-image rows are derived with the shared RetainedSourcePageTrace::map_row contract (subtract the height of every deletion interval ending at or before the row). This ledger records only reviewed decisions: an empty `repairs` list means no repair has yet been measured and frozen. Tests must read reviewed expectations from this committed file and must never regenerate and accept their own expected values during a regression run.

repair_record: source_page: u32 (1-based physical source PDF page)
crop_edges: [left, right] (original Latin-column crop, original coordinates)
bands: [[top, bottom]] (retained body bands, original coordinates)
adjacent_prose: {above: string, below: string} (exact Latin landmarks framing the repair)
mask_rectangles: [[left, top, right, bottom]] (normalized half-open, when disposition = mask)
row_exclusions: [[top, bottom]] (normalized half-open original rows, when disposition = row_exclusion)
preservation_boundary: string (why the erase/exclusion removes no Latin)
copied_height: {before: u32, after: u32} (measured copied blank rows)
neighbor_gap: u32 (ordinary neighboring-line gap in original rows)

scale.note: global_scale_for samples raw rendered columns across the ranges and applies no furniture masks or duplicate exclusions. Record the measured baseline and final production scale here once a diagnostic trace has run; a material change triggers the narrow resolution specified in Phase 1.
